officialLinks.label: GPA formula, grades, repeats, Fresh Start, honors

helpIntro: Ohio State uses a 4.0 point-hour ratio. Enter semester credit hours and final grades; E and EN count at 0.0, while PA/NP, S/U, transfer K credit, incompletes and withdrawals are excluded from GPA.
helpNote: For the standard undergraduate record. Graduate/professional careers use separate records. Repeat Impact estimates approved Grade Forgiveness only; ordinary repeats and Fresh Start need separate handling. Exceptional/historical marks may require review.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9. Together, 21.9 / 6 = 3.650.

gradeExplanations.E: E is zero points; credit hours remain in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.EN: EN is treated as E in the point-hour ratio.
gradeExplanations.EM: Credit by examination; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.K: Transfer credit; excluded from Ohio State GPA.
gradeExplanations.KD: Transfer credit notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NG: Grade unreported; excluded pending a final grade.
gradeExplanations.P: Progress mark; excluded until final grade.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory S/U mark; excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: Ohio State course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: E and EN count at zero; excluded marks contribute neither points nor GPA hours.

specialTypes.name: External transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades and GPA from prior institutions do not transfer into the Ohio State GPA.

specialTypes.name: Exceptional/historical grading record
specialTypes.note: NEN/UEN and exceptional or historical grading can depend on policy period; confirm transcript treatment.

specialTypes.name: Graduate or professional career course
specialTypes.note: Graduate/professional point-hour ratios are separate from the undergraduate record.

repeatPolicy.note: Use Repeat Impact only for an approved second-attempt Grade Forgiveness case. The second grade replaces the first in Ohio State cumulative GPA even if lower; both remain on the transcript.
